title: Where and What to Eat in Stone Town
excerpt: From street food at Forodhani to rooftop restaurants: where and what to eat in Stone Town.
body:
## Street food

- [Forodhani Gardens](/blog/forodhani-night-market/): Zanzibar pizza, grilled seafood.
- Urojo (Zanzibar mix).
- Fresh sugar cane juice.

## Local restaurants

Simple restaurants with pilau, biryani and fish curry.

## Rooftops

Rooftop restaurants offer views over the city and the sea.

## Coffee

Small coffee stalls with strong coffee served in tiny cups.

## Ramadan

During Ramadan, eating in public during the day is discouraged.
